alpha_hypothesis.playbook_alignment: Tests a new deterministic candidate-quality field while avoiding LLM soft-ranking, candidate-pool data limits, and nearby queue-lag/capacity retunes.

backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows; accepted exp-20260519-028 baseline artifact plus default-off state-surface paper overlay replay.

gate1.baseline_note: Uses accepted exp-20260519-028 queue-lag support notional as Gate 1 baseline.

gate3.hard_rule: No filter, ranking, or candidate gate changed; only paper notional changes for already-selected trades.

history_check.anti_repeat: Not a queue-lag scalar retry, global capacity retune, breadth-only scalar, volume/near-high/ret5 threshold retry, candidate-pool expansion, SEC text scalar, or LLM soft-ranking experiment.
history_check.exp-20260519-028: Accepted queue-lag support notional; this experiment freezes it and tests a distinct absolute score quality field.
history_check.recent_rejections: Avoids cached AI-infra pool expansion, residual core-misfit expansion, pure SPY T+1 SEC haircuts, rank4 no-sample retries, and LLM soft-ranking.
history_check.score_related_prior: Prior state-surface score work used queue-level score dispersion, score expansion, and rank-1 score isolation; no accepted rule after exp-20260519-028 tested candidate-level absolute score support.

hypothesis: Already-selected state-surface paper candidates with high absolute composite score are not just relatively well ranked; they carry enough standalone quality to deserve a bounded notional support scalar.
interpretation: Absolute score support improved the default-off state-surface paper overlay without changing core trades, filters, ranking, or live/default orders.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm: LLM soft-ranking data remains sparse/PIT-limited; this tests a replayable deterministic score field.

next_evidence_needed: Promote only as shared default-off paper metadata; keep forward tail/concentration monitoring before any live adapter work.

parameters.condition: selected state-surface paper candidate score >= threshold
parameters.profile_priority: applies after the accepted queue-lag support notional stack and before recent-repeat paper metadata

protocol_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: capital allocation: high absolute-score selected state-surface candidates may deserve more paper capital independent of queue rank.
protocol_answers.2_history_check: Related score work used dispersion/gap fields before exp-20260519-028; this is not a queue-lag/capacity retune and does not rely on LLM or data-limited pool expansion.
protocol_answers.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least two EV-improved windows, zero EV-regressed windows, adjusted trades >=8 across >=2 windows, max DD drift <=0.5pp, single-ticker positive share <=50%.
